generatedBy: scripts/landmarks/landmark-targets-next.ts (ranking, raw list in docs/reports/landmark-targets-next-raw.json) + photo briefs (scripts/landmarks/<id>-brief.md) and a hand read of the contact sheets
method: Candidates: OSM buildings and POI nodes with wikidata/wikipedia/historic/tourism/amenity/building tags in the canal belt and just outside it (S 52.352, W 4.866, N 52.386, E 4.928; within 2.6 km of the Dam), mapped to BAG pands; already modelled (covers.json models, signature-landmarks footprints, manualCatalogue suppressOsmIds) dropped. Score = ride exposure (ride-visibility.ts: 1500 seeded bike routes between teachable destinations, 5 m samples, street walls visible within 60 m) x recognisability (2 with a Wikipedia article, 1.4 wikidata only, 1.2 monument only). Then ruled by hand: canal-house rows, no open panorama, already modelled.
ride: ride-visibility/v1: teachable destinations ≤ 6 km of the Dam, seeded pairs 1–6 km, bike graph shortest paths, 5 m samples, walls ≥ 2 m within 60 m on their outer side with a 2D footprint sightline; score = Σ sample m × passes × visible facing-wall m

targets.name: Politiebureau Raampoort (Marnixstraat 148, 1888, Willem Springer)
targets.reason: Rijksmonument with a Wikipedia article; clock tower, crenellated round corner over the Singelgracht, banded brick and round-headed windows. Clear, square panoramas of all four street walls (2017-2023). Compact (348 m2). Built in this lane: politiebureau-raampoort.

targets.name: Banks Mansion (Herengracht 519-525 / Vijzelstraat, 1923, former bank)
targets.reason: Stone corner block with a colonnade ground floor, two wrought-iron balconies, a mansard with dormers and a lettered corner entrance. Square 2017-2025 panoramas of both fronts and the corner. Next in line after Raampoort.

targets.name: Voormalige Nederlandsch-Indische Handelsbank, Singel 250 (1910-1912, Van Rossem & Vuyk)
targets.reason: Highest ride exposure of all candidates (Raadhuisstraat / Singel corner, 23.9 km of sampled route within sight); rijksmonument with a Wikipedia article; rusticated stone base and pilasters, crop quality good. Held for a later lane: the BAG pand (1797 m2) also holds a block of canal houses on Singel and Herengracht, which the model would have to draw too.
